summary: A useful three-target result: cropped SAM3 masks with 2, 2 and 3 prompt points isolate plausible visible blades. Cropping and correcting the target helped; 4x enlargement showed no clear visual boundary advantage. Dense foliage is still unresolved. These are provisional labels, not validated ground truth.

decisions.observation: Full image merges multiple fan blades; crop candidate 0 isolates the intended leftward leaflet. Upscaling changes confidence much more than visible shape. Whole-image 2x does not fix fan merging.
Candidate 0 isolates a plausible short blade beside the main stem; candidate 2 includes the stem and candidate 1 floods the scene. Crop 1x and 4x have similar visible outlines.

Rejected. The tentative point was misplaced on a cluster edge. No returned candidate establishes one leaf. Correct the point using the coordinate grid, rather than calling this successful segmentation.
Rejected as a single leaflet: adding one negative point still leaves multiple fan blades in candidate 0. Confidence increased without fixing the identity error.

Candidate 0 provisionally retained: the intended leftward blade is separated from neighboring fan blades. Two prompt points. The initial crop already isolated it; the negative point was not necessary to create the initial separation. Fine edge and junction pixels remain uncertain.
Candidate 0 is visually similar to native crop. Higher confidence does not prove a more accurate boundary.

Crop candidate 0 provisionally retained. A negative point on the main stem makes candidate 2 local as well; candidate 0 was already plausible before correction. No demonstrated need for extra upscaling.

Crop candidate 0 provisionally retained as the visible diagonal blade. Replaced the misplaced positive point and added two negatives (cluster and neighboring blade). This changes prompt placement as well as exclusions; it is not proof that negatives alone recovered the target. The surrounding dense cluster remains unresolved.

effort.note: Includes one relocated positive point plus four added negative points. Three target crops and visual candidate selection also required; not a matched-effort comparison against 84 hand polygons.
